programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: An entrepreneur from Salt Lake City hopes to convince the Sharks of the delicious and healthy merits of his energy bars fortified with protein from crickets; an inventor from Vista, California shows how his garage lock will protect everyone from easy break-ins, a confident entrepreneur from Needham, MA, tries to school the Sharks, even those without hair, on a “paradigm shift in morning grooming”—his shower cap to fix bedhead, and two young men from Chicago, IL, try to woo the Sharks on their e-commerce platform for digital textbook rentals. And, an amazing update on this season’s newest success story—Fiber Fix, created by entrepreneurs from Orem, Utah, in which Lori Greiner invested.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A guitar player from Dallas, TX hopes to sing his way into a deal for his service that helps people find and hire music instructors; a firefighter from San Diego, CA has come up with a simple way to stop costly, accidental fire sprinkler activations; two friends from Salt Lake City, UT show how they can turn fire and water into a battery charger; and two men from Chicago, IL hope the Sharks will get on board with their indoor trackless train that can be used at the mall or even private parties. In a follow up segment, Tiffany Krumins from Auburn, GA and creator of Ava the Elephant medicine dispenser gives an update on her business, which Barbara invested in during Season One.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Self-professed wine connoisseur Kevin O’Leary gives advice to a lady from Solano Beach, CA on her lighter, healthier alternative to a full-bodied wine. Likewise, Robert Herjavec has some suggestions for a former merchant marine from Anacortes, WA on his innovative, deep-sea treasure hunting business. Three men from San Francisco, CA hope to paddle their way into a deal with a collapsible kayak that folds up like the traditional Japanese art of origami, and a couple from Pleasant Hill, CA reveal to the Sharks the surprising twist they put into their decadent cinnamon rolls. Also, an update on Jim Tselikis and Sabin Lomac from Los Angeles, CA and their Maine lobster roll food truck business, which Barbara Corcoran invested in during Season 4.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: An entrepreneur from Marina Del Rey, CA wants an investment in his e-commerce flower business, which offers bouquets shipped direct from farms on an active volcano for just $40 flat; a man from Encinitas, CA thinks his anti-aging lifting strips for mouth wrinkles is a game changer. A 19-year-old from Plano, TX invented a "breakaway" hanger as a third-grader which collapses under pressure for easy on and off; and two friends from Brooklyn, NY pitch their compostable party tableware made from renewable plant materials. And, Kevin O'Leary follows up on his and Mark Cuban's recent investment in Groovebook, which tripled its sales in just 5 days after airing earlier this season and also drops by "Jimmy Kimmel Live."

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A college sophomore from Oak Brook, IL raised in a traditional Indian family, wants to make her own American dream come true with her flat-folding, reusable storage box. A couple from Carmel, IN hope to cook up a deal with their reinvented cookware, two exuberant moms from Solana Beach, CA have taken the pain out of shoe shopping for your kids with an iPad app that measures foot sizes, and two men from Aurora, IL designed a quick, simple solution to tying up a water balloon. In a first of its kind follow-up, many of the amazing success stories from “Shark Tank” are highlighted, with the entrepreneurs discussing their experiences and how their businesses have grown since coming to the Tank.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Three men from Jackson, NJ with 60 years of painting experience among them, cause the Sharks to get in a feeding frenzy over their convenient way to store a wet paintbrush. Two moms from Austin, TX hope at least one Shark will make an offer for their portable mat that fits into an ultra-compact pouch, two Harvard Business School grads from New York, NY devised a unique way to provide a chef-designed, pre-portioned nutritious meal right to your door, and two men from Park City, UT offer a healthier version of a favorite breakfast with their whole-grain flapjack and waffle mix. Also, an update on Melissa & Rick Hinnant from Leander, TX and their Grace & Lace business that makes hand knitted socks and legwarmers, which Barbara invested in during Season 5.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Two Dallas entrepreneurs demonstrate their smart light bulb which can be programmed from a mobile phone for home or business, a father/son team from Las Vegas have a high-tech replacement for a cork that helps preserve wine and olive oil, parents from Washington, D.C. unveil their subscription service of carefully-curated children's books, but they only have 85 subscribers to date, and a Sarasota, FL woman has a fort-building construction kit for kids that makes castles, pirate ships and cars. Plus, a follow-up on Breathometer, one of the show's most popular deals -- 5 Sharks invested in it earlier this season. It's a breathalyzer app that works with your smart phone to check if you are over the legal alcohol limit and if you are, can call a taxi for you, recommend a hotel and more.

programme.title: Nate und der Colonel
programme.desc: Nach dem Bürgerkrieg reisen ein ehemaliger Sklave und sein Jugendfreund nach Westen und treffen auf einen Chippewa‑Stamm, der ihr Leben verändert.

programme.title: Vergeltung - Revenge is coming
programme.desc: Nachdem ihr Ehemann von einem Serienkiller brutal ermordet wurde, sinnt die verwitwete Siedlerin Mary O'Malley (June Dietrich) auf Rache. Ausgestattet mit einem Pferd und einer Waffe lässt sie alles hinter sich, um den Mörder zu jagen. Auf ihrer Mission trifft Mary nicht nur den gutherzigen Verkäufer Mr. Barley (Kevin Crow), sondern gerät auch in Konflikt mit einem Kopfgeldjäger...

programme.title: High Lonesome - Gerechtikeit ist nicht genug
programme.desc: Walter Osgood (Louis Gossett Jr.) lebt als letzter Schwarzer in einem kleinen Dorf. Die Einwohner dieses Dorfes sind verantwortlich für den Tod seiner Frau und das Verschwinden seines Sohnes. Als Walter dem kleinen Charlie (Joseph Mazzello) behilflich ist, dessen Vater durch einen gezielten Schuss vom sicheren Flammentod zu erlösen, haben die Einwohner des Dorfes endlich einen Grund, sich des letzten Schwarzen in Ihrem Dorf zu entledigen.

programme.title: Ferner Donner
programme.desc: Der hungernde Cree-Indianer Voice stiehlt eine Kuh, die zum Viehbestand der Regierung gehört. Die Gebirgspolizei nimmt den Dieb sofort gefangen. Der Soldat Dan Candy hat Mitleid mit der Rothaut und löst die Fesseln. Von da an nimmt das Schicksal seinen Lauf, denn Dan Candy muss laut Vorschrift Voice verfolgen und wird auf verhängnisvolle Weise von dem verängstigten Indianer getötet.Jetzt will die Gebirgspolizei diesen Tod rächen und mit Kanonendonner und Schwadronen wird Jagd auf die Rothaut gemacht. Dem ursprünglich eigentlich harmlosen Kuhdiebstal folgt nun ein blutiges Massaker.

programme.title: Der schnellste Colt von River Falls
programme.desc: Gunman Dave, Augenzeuge eines heimtückischen Mordes an einem Richter, kommt der Mörderbande auf die Spur, die eine ganze Stadt terrorisiert

programme.title: Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Mason (Christian Slater) hat gerade erst seinen lange vermissten Vater wiedergetroffen, da geraten auch beide schon in einen Zugüberfall. Johns Vater wird dabei im hitzigen Gefecht erschossen und er selbst schwer verwundet. Auf einer nahe gelegenen Ranch kann er zwar wieder zu Kräften kommen, doch tatsächlich lauert hier erneut tödliche Gefahr. Der Bruder der Ranchbesitzerin ist der Kopf der Gangsterbande - und der Mörder seines Vaters...

programme.title: Big Jake
programme.desc: Texas, 1909. Die Welt verändert sich – Automobile ersetzen Pferde, Telegramme Pistolen. Doch als eine brutale Bande unter der Führung von John Fain die McCandles-Ranch überfällt, mehrere Menschen ermordet und den kleinen Jacob „Little Jake“ McCandles entführt, zeigt sich: Der Wilde Westen ist noch nicht gezähmt. Die Entführer fordern eine Million Dollar Lösegeld. Statt Armee oder Texas Rangers schickt Martha McCandles einen Mann, der mit der alten Welt noch vertraut ist: ihren lange entfremdeten Ehemann Jacob „Big Jake“ McCandles, ein rauer Einzelgänger mit Revolver, Hund und einem Sinn für Gerechtigkeit. Gemeinsam mit einem alten Apachenfreund und widerwillig auch mit seinen Söhnen, nimmt Big Jake die Verfolgung auf – durch gefährliches Grenzland bis nach Mexiko. Die Reise ist geprägt von Misstrauen, Konflikten und der Frage, ob alte Methoden noch greifen. Als es zum Showdown kommt, muss Big Jake nicht nur gegen die Entführer kämpfen, sondern auch um die Wiederherstellung seiner Familie.

programme.desc: Dans le film "The Hamiltons", nous faisions connaissance avec une famille quelque peu dysfonctionnelle, composée de vampires sans réelle attache familiale. Dans cette suite, le clan, poursuivi par la justice, est contraint de fuir les Etats-Unis et de partir s’installer en Angleterre sous une nouvelle identité, les Thompson. programme.desc: A Prague, le corps de Gregory Moore, un journaliste américain, est retrouvé dans un parc. Il est déclaré mort à la morgue, mais il est victime d'une machination. programme.desc: Des chercheurs en Antarctique sont enlevés et entraînés sous terre par une équipe de survivants nazis qui planifient la renaissance du Troisième Reich.

programme.title: Shadow
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un jeune soldat part pour une excursion en VTT, il rencontre la fille de ses rêves ainsi qu'un groupe d'habitants violents qui veulent les voir morts à tout prix.

programme.title: Heartstopper
programme.desc: Dans un hôpital de banlieue presque désert, une nuit de tempête devient un cauchemar absolu lorsque Jonathan Chambers, un tueur en série exécuté quelques heures plus tôt, se réveille sur la table d’autopsie. Son cœur, pourtant arrêté, se remet à battre… un battement sec, violent, monstrueux, qui fait vibrer son thorax déchiré. - Arrachant ses sutures, ses côtes ouvertes comme les dents d’un piège, Chambers se relève dans un bain de sang. Chaque pas laisse une trace rouge sombre sur le sol. Son corps brisé ne cherche pas à guérir : il saigne, claque, grince, comme porté par quelque chose de plus sombre que la vie.

programme.desc: Um ano após o suicídio de Vincent Van Gogh, Armand Roulin (Douglas Booth) encontra uma carta por ele enviada ao irmão Theo, que jamais chegou ao seu destino. programme.title: Dinero sangriento
programme.desc: A lo largo de más de dos décadas, For the Love of Money sigue la historia real de un inmigrante israelí que busca su parte del sueño americano. La historia comienza en Tel Aviv en 1973, donde un joven Izek crece en un casino ilegal lleno de gánsteres que opera detrás del bar de su familia. El casino es un refugio para personajes poco recomendables que intentan corromperlo y llevarlo a su estilo de vida. Cuando la violencia y el crimen alcanzan a él y a su familia, Izek (Yuda Levi) y los suyos se mudan a Los Ángeles. Con la esperanza de empezar de nuevo, Izek persigue sus ambiciones de convertirse en un joven empresario desarrollando pequeños negocios, comprando bienes raíces y administrando un taller mecánico. El éxito parece acompañarlo en cada paso y, tras enamorarse de la bella Aline (Delphine Chaneac), la suerte parece estar de su lado. Sin embargo, no pasa mucho tiempo antes de que el mundo del crimen del que Izek intentó escapar lo siga persistentemente. Amenazado por un gánster peligrosamente temperamental (James Caan), su primo criminal (Oded Fehr) e incluso un narcotraficante colombiano (Steven Bauer), Izek descubre que empezar de cero con una hoja limpia es casi imposible. Mientras quienes lo rodean caen víctimas de las promesas de dinero fácil a punta de pistola, la violencia rodea a Izek hasta que no le queda más opción que enfrentarse a ella. For the Love of Money es una historia real de crimen, familia, amor, pérdida y las tentaciones del dinero fácil, basada en la vida del productor ejecutivo Izek Shomof.

programme.title: Pesadilla diabolica
programme.desc: Ben y Marian Rolf alquilan una antigua y majestuosa mansión en el campo como refugio de verano para ellos, su hijo de doce años Davey y la tía Elizabeth de Ben. No pueden rechazar la oferta de alquiler que les hacen los propietarios de la casa, los hermanos Roz y Arnold Allardyce, a pesar de algunas reservas. La primera de esas reservas es que deben encargarse del mantenimiento de la casa por sí mismos, lo que Ben considera un trabajo demasiado grande, especialmente para Marian y las tareas del hogar. Según Marian, el tamaño de la casa es un desperdicio. La segunda, y quizás más importante, es que la anciana madre de los Allardyce permanecerá en su habitación, y los Rolf deben dejarle una bandeja de comida fuera de su puerta tres veces al día, tarea que Marian promete asumir sola, sin que ningún otro miembro de la familia entre en esa ala aislada para no perturbar la paz de la señora Allardyce. Al llegar a la casa el primer día, encuentran una nota de Roz y Arnold diciendo que tuvieron que irse por una emergencia, dejando solo las llaves necesarias y sin dirección ni número de teléfono donde localizarlos. A medida que avanza el verano, los miembros de la familia empiezan a mostrar comportamientos extraños e inexplicables, y cosas inusuales comienzan a suceder en la casa. El comportamiento más marcado es la obsesión de Marian por renovar la casa hasta convertirla en lo que dice que quiere, o al menos eso da a entender. Estos sucesos amenazan tanto la dinámica familiar como la vida de cada uno de los cuatro. Las respuestas a lo que ocurre pueden estar detrás de la puerta cerrada y a menudo con llave del dormitorio de la señora Allardyce.

programme.title: La Cavalcata Verso Il 21° Scudetto, Partita Dopo Partita | Serie A 2025/26
programme.desc: Un viaggio attraverso la stagione, un partita alla volta, con tutti gli HL extended.

programme.title: KAWASAKI Z1100SE: Hypernaked a Doppio Test
programme.desc: Due tester mettono alla prova la Z1100 SE in Sicilia, analizzando ogni dettaglio della hypernaked Kawasaki, dal motore alla ciclistica, per una recensione completa.

programme.title: Triumph 900 GT PRO: Test Lungo Viaggio
programme.desc: Da Milano all'Isola di Man con la Triumph Tiger 900 GT Pro per 5.000 km. Scopri le prestazioni e la nostra opinione sull'equipaggiamento usato.

programme.title: Tagliando Ambulanza: Costi e Processi
programme.desc: Scopri come si esegue il tagliando su un'ambulanza Fiat Ducato, il costo degli interventi e l'importanza della manutenzione per la sicurezza dei mezzi di soccorso.

programme.title: Astra HDX: Novità con Stile Classico
programme.desc: Scopri l'Astra HDX: un camion italiano potente e tradizionale, perfetto per i cantieri. Robusto, con tecnologia essenziale e progettato per condizioni estreme. Orgoglio italiano.

programme.title: 100 KM dei Campioni con Valentino Rossi
programme.desc: Scopri l'evento al Ranch di Rossi: motori, gare emozionanti e la vittoria di Bagnaia e Fernandez. Dentro l'atmosfera unica con interviste ai campioni e dietro le quinte.

programme.title: Stefano Pinciaroli e due MV Agusta
programme.desc: Stefano Pinciaroli prova due MV Agusta in pista e cucina una ricetta gourmet con ingredienti a km zero. Quale moto amerà di più? Scopritelo!

programme.title: Chef on Track: da Michelin alla velocità
programme.desc: Moto e cucina si incontrano. Lorenzo Cogo, giovane stella Michelin, mostra la sua abilità in pista e ai fornelli. Con Stefano Gaeta, tra MV Agusta, piatti gourmet e storie spericolate.

programme.title: Aprilia Tuareg Rally: è il MEGA TOP?
programme.desc: Scopriamo la Aprilia Tuareg Rally 660 alla HAT Sanremo-Sestriere. Versione specializzata per sterrati con caratteristiche uniche e prezzo di 13.999 €. Pronti a due giorni di avventura?

programme.title: Prova moto elettrica HONDA WN7
programme.desc: Abbiamo testato la nuova moto elettrica di Honda, scoprendone pregi e difetti.

programme.title: Lancia Beta: Storia e Prova Dimenticata
programme.desc: Esplora la storia della Lancia Beta Berlina, dalla sua presentazione nel 1972 all'oblio. Scopri successi, fallimenti e innovazioni della vettura che affascinò ma fu dimenticata.

programme.title: La Rolls Royce Camargue del 1978
programme.desc: Nel 1978 era l auto piu costosa del mondo. Storia, design Pininfarina, numeri e valore attuale della Rolls Royce Camargue, prodotta in soli 524 esemplari.

programme.title: BMW iX3 2026: Pregi e difetti
programme.desc: Scopri il nuovo SUV elettrico BMW iX3 2026: efficienza, tecnologia avanzata e guidabilità della piattaforma Neue Klasse. In arrivo a marzo 2026 da 69.900 euro.

programme.title: Yamaha vs Aprilia: la comparativa
programme.desc: Scopri la sfida tra Yamaha Ténéré 700 Rally e Aprilia Tuareg 660 Rally: motore, ciclistica, comfort e guida off-road a confronto. Quale preferisci?

programme.title: Segreti del Nightliner con Lacuna Coil
programme.desc: Scopri il mondo del Nightliner, il lussuoso bus delle rockstar che ospita artisti come i Lacuna Coil, con comfort e sicurezza per viaggiare come a casa durante i tour europei.

programme.title: Gas a 270 Km/h con F. Beretta
programme.desc: Federico Beretta, chef di Como, affronta la sua prima esperienza a 270 km/h nel format Chef on Track, supportato da MV Agusta, e sorprende con un riso in cagnone.

programme.title: Aprilia ieri vs oggi: Bernardelle parla
programme.desc: Giulio Bernardelle confronta l'Aprilia degli anni '90 con quella attuale, evidenziando cambiamenti tecnici e manageriali, la perdita di innovazione e il nuovo scenario delle corse.

programme.title: Filippo La Mantia: Storie e Moto
programme.desc: Scopriamo Filippo La Mantia tra moto, cucina e fotografia. Con Stefano Gaeta, viaggiamo in pista e ai fornelli, esplorando il suo amore per la libertà e la semplicità culinaria.

programme.title: Enduro GP Italia con Triumph TF 250-E
programme.desc: Abbiamo corso l'Enduro GP d'Italia, mettendo alla prova la Triumph TF 250-E. Freddo e pioggia, poi sole e caldo, su un percorso impegnativo. Esperienza unica con moto impeccabile.

programme.title: Da ingegnere a chef a 5 stelle
programme.desc: Guido Paternollo, ex ingegnere, si cimenta tra moto e alta cucina al Park Hyatt di Milano. Scopri il suo percorso e la creazione di un club sandwich gluten free iconico.

programme.title: Suzuki Vitara 2025, nuova e moderna
programme.desc: La Suzuki eVitara, su piattaforma elettrica, affiancherà la Vitara Hybrid senza sostituirla.

programme.title: 10 Segreti della Ford Puma Gen-E
programme.desc: Scopri la Ford Puma Gen-E: design unico, prestazioni elettriche superiori, spazio interno ottimizzato e tecnologia avanzata. Un'opzione interessante per un crossover elettrico pratico.

programme.title: Mercedes GLC Elettrica 2026: 305 km in 10 min
programme.desc: Esplora la nuova Mercedes GLC 2026: un SUV elettrico innovativo con 490 CV, fino a 715 km di autonomia e ricarica ultraveloce. Scopri il design, l'Hyperscreen e le prestazioni su strada.

programme.title: Difendersi da un'aggressione in auto
programme.desc: Scopri come proteggerti in auto da aggressioni con Stefano Gennaccari, maestro di arti marziali. Consigli pratici su prevenzione, legittima difesa e sicurezza al volante.

programme.title: Chef e Moto: Avventure Stellari EP 1
programme.desc: Scopri Chef on Track con Tommaso Arrigoni che mescola cucina stellata e adrenalina in pista. Risotto alla milanese e MV Agusta F3 sotto il sole a Cremona Circuit.

programme.title: Ducati Multistrada V4 Rally: il nostro test
programme.desc: Test della Multistrada V4 Rally 2026, scoprendo notevoli miglioramenti nella ciclistica ed elettronica. Novità: sospensioni Marzocchi, radar e nuovi riding modes.

programme.title: KTM 990 RC R: versatilità e potenza
programme.desc: KTM ritorna nel segmento sportivo con la 990 RC R, una moto che combina prestazioni in pista con usabilità su strada, grazie al motore LC8c e una ciclistica avanzata.

programme.title: XPeng P7+ 500 km in 12 minuti
programme.desc: XPeng P7+ e una berlina elettrica da oltre 5 metri con ricarica 800 Volt, fino a 500 km in 12 minuti, guida assistita evoluta, tanto spazio interno e prezzo competitivo.

programme.title: Mercedes Classe C SW 2022: Prova e Dettagli
programme.desc: Scopri pro e contro della Mercedes Classe C SW 2022 confrontata con BMW Serie 3 e Audi A4. Prova dettagliata con il 'pagellone di Automoto.it'.

programme.title: Mazda CX-5 2026: Classe ed Eleganza
programme.desc: Scopri la nuova Mazda CX-5 2026 con design evoluto, interni moderni e potente motore mild hybrid. Prezzo a partire da 35.900 euro.

programme.title: Opel Grandland 2025: Nuova Ibrida Plug-In
programme.desc: Opel Grandland 2025 offre propulsori elettrificati e tecnologie innovative. Spazioso e confortevole, include sistemi avanzati di assistenza alla guida e opzioni di ricarica rapida. Prezzi da 35.500 euro.

programme.title: Perché Audi RS 5 è ibrida plug-in
programme.desc: Prova in pista e su strada della nuova Audi RS 5 plug-in hybrid: V6 biturbo, 639 CV, peso elevato, tecnologia di guida e il motivo dietro la scelta legata alle emissioni.

programme.title: Rimettiamo in azione l'Unimog
programme.desc: Matteo Valenti riporta al lavoro un Unimog U1450 L del 1995, rinnovato con gomme MPT80, affrontando ostacoli in un'antica cava per trasportare marmo rosa di Candoglia-Ornavasso.

programme.title: Kia Sportage 2025: 10 Cose da Scoprire
programme.desc: Nuova Kia Sportage: design futuristico, ampia gamma motori e tecnologie avanzate. Versatile e confortevole, è un SUV completo e adatto a ogni esigenza.

programme.title: Elettrica Skoda a Prezzo Diesel
programme.desc: La Skoda Elroq è un SUV elettrico dal prezzo competitivo: da 34.000 euro e con incentivi scende a 18.000 euro. Con 204 CV e autonomia di 360 km, è spaziosa, comoda e tecnologica.

programme.title: Dacia Bigster: Hybrid o GPL? Test
programme.desc: Dacia Bigster: Full Hybrid offre comfort e fluidità, mentre GPL è vantaggioso per consumi e costi. Test prestazioni, spazio e autonomia evidenziano GPL come scelta più economica e pratica.

programme.title: Il miglior ibrido Honda Civic 2026
programme.desc: Scopri la nuova Honda Civic 2026, un'ibrida efficiente e sportiva, con design aggiornato, qualità giapponese e tecnologia avanzata per un'esperienza di guida unica.

programme.title: Segreti della Produzione dei Cerchi in Lega
programme.desc: Esploriamo i segreti della produzione dei cerchi in lega del GMP Group, dal processo di fusione alla finitura e verniciatura, con tecnologie avanzate e intelligenza artificiale.

programme.title: Mazda MX-5 vs GR86: quale scegliere?
programme.desc: Mazda MX-5 ND, leggera e autentica, a confronto con la Toyota GR86. Scopri la differenza nella guida e nella filosofia costruttiva delle due sportive.

programme.title: Brivio Rossi ha cambiato Yamaha
programme.desc: Davide Brivio racconta l arrivo di Valentino Rossi in Yamaha, il cambio di mentalita nel team e l esperienza con Trackhouse Aprilia fino alla vittoria di Raul Fernandez.

programme.title: Ferrari 849 Testarossa: più della SF90
programme.desc: La Ferrari 849 Testarossa è una berlinetta ibrida con un nome leggendario. Dotata di un V8 biturbo e tre motori elettrici, raggiunge 1050 cv e ridefinisce le prestazioni con accelerazioni da record.

programme.title: Jaecoo 7: 1200 km con un pieno
programme.desc: Jaecoo 7, SUV cinese, va testato da Milano a Puglia. Con un pieno di carburante ed elettricità, ha percorso 1128 km, avanzando 82 km di autonomia. Efficiente a 18,5 km/l su autostrada.

programme.title: Accessori Essenziali per Camper e Van
programme.desc: Scopri 10 accessori indispensabili per il tuo camper: dashcam, cunei, inverter, pannelli solari, fari a LED e tanto altro per viaggi sicuri e confortevoli.

programme.title: Guida al Tram Hitachi Torino
programme.desc: Scopri l'evoluzione del tram, da modelli storici del 1933 ai moderni Hitachi Torino, simboli di innovazione e progresso tecnologico.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Es kommt ja selten vor, aber diesmal will Endora Darrin wirklich einmal eine Freude machen: Sie zaubert ihm sein Traumauto vor die Tür - den 150 000 Dollar teuren Reactor Mach II. Darrin ist begeistert - bis er erfährt, daß die Konstrukteure über das Verschwinden des Prototyps völlig verzweifelt sind ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: Corn Is As High As A Guernsey'S Eye, The
programme.desc: Tante Clara besucht Samantha und klagt ihr Leid: Da sich alle über ihr Alter lustig machen, würde sie sich am liebsten in etwas ganz Nützliches verwandeln - zum Beispiel in eine Kuh. Als Samantha wenig später Darrin in der Werbeagentur abholt, sieht sie in der Halle die berühmte Preiskuh Ginger für Mortons Milchprodukte-Werbung. Samantha denkt, Tante Clara habe ernst gemacht. Sie nimmt Ginger mit nach Hause und versucht, ihr die Flausen auszureden ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: Trial And Error Of Aunt Clara
programme.desc: Tante Clara (Marion Lorne) weilte auf Lady Montagues Schloß in Schottland, wo sie während einer Jagd einen ihrer Jagdhunde erschossen hat. Nun soll sie aus dem Hexenbund ausgeschlossen werden. Samantha wird zu Tante Claras Verteidigung bestellt. Eine turbulente Gerichtsverhandlung nimmt ihren Lauf ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Endora will Darrin als heimlichen Ehebrecher entlarven. Ohne sein Wissen schenkt sie ihm drei Wünsche. Als sich Darrin in Larrys Auftrag mit dem hübschen Model Buffy beschäftigen muß, sieht dies Endora schon als Erfüllung eines heimlichen Wunsches an. Tatsächlich aber täuscht sich Endora. Als Darrin seine echten Wünsche äußert, hat sie erst mal Sendepause ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Als sich Darrin in der Arbeit nicht mehr an einen Kunden erinnern kann, beschließt er, mit Hilfe seines Sohnes sein Gedächtnis zu trainieren. Er ahnt nicht, daß ihm Endora mittels Zauberei ein perfektes Erinnerungsvermögen zukommen läßt. Von nun an wird Darrin zum unerträglichen Besserwisser, der nicht nur seine Kunden nervt ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Samantha ist dabei, für eine Wohltätigkeitsausstellung ein Stilleben zu malen. Natürlich muß ihr Endora dabei ins Handwerk pfuschen: Sie zaubert ein Landschaftsgemälde des berühmten französischen Malers Henri Monchet hin, das sie sich in einer Ausstellung 'ausgeliehen' hat. Prompt gewinnt es den ersten Preis - und findet sofort einen Käufer ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Samantha und Darrin werden von Darrins altem Schulfreund Charlie Harper (Angus Duncan) auf ein Wochenende eingeladen. Charlie ist ein schwerreicher Mann geworden. Doch während er erstaunlich normal geblieben ist, trägt seine Frau Daphne (Joanna Moore) ihre Nase ziemlich hoch. Als sie ihre Gäste spüren läßt, daß sie Darrin für einen Versager hält, kuriert Samantha Daphnes Dünkel auf Hexenart ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Wieder einmal bringt Tante Clara ein paar Zaubersprüche durcheinander - aus Versehen zaubert sie Königin Victoria (Jane Connell) ins Wohnzimmer. Ausgerechnet als Larry (David White) mit einem Kunden, dem überaus rechthaberischen Mr. Morgan (Robert H. Harris), verhandelt. Der gerät sofort mit der Königin in Streit - was Larry und Darrin einen lukrativen Werbeauftrag einbringt ...

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: An entrepreneur from Salt Lake City hopes to convince the Sharks of the delicious and healthy merits of his energy bars fortified with protein from crickets; an inventor from Vista, California shows how his garage lock will protect everyone from easy break-ins, a confident entrepreneur from Needham, MA, tries to school the Sharks, even those without hair, on a “paradigm shift in morning grooming”—his shower cap to fix bedhead, and two young men from Chicago, IL, try to woo the Sharks on their e-commerce platform for digital textbook rentals. And, an amazing update on this season’s newest success story—Fiber Fix, created by entrepreneurs from Orem, Utah, in which Lori Greiner invested.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A guitar player from Dallas, TX hopes to sing his way into a deal for his service that helps people find and hire music instructors; a firefighter from San Diego, CA has come up with a simple way to stop costly, accidental fire sprinkler activations; two friends from Salt Lake City, UT show how they can turn fire and water into a battery charger; and two men from Chicago, IL hope the Sharks will get on board with their indoor trackless train that can be used at the mall or even private parties. In a follow up segment, Tiffany Krumins from Auburn, GA and creator of Ava the Elephant medicine dispenser gives an update on her business, which Barbara invested in during Season One.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Self-professed wine connoisseur Kevin O’Leary gives advice to a lady from Solano Beach, CA on her lighter, healthier alternative to a full-bodied wine. Likewise, Robert Herjavec has some suggestions for a former merchant marine from Anacortes, WA on his innovative, deep-sea treasure hunting business. Three men from San Francisco, CA hope to paddle their way into a deal with a collapsible kayak that folds up like the traditional Japanese art of origami, and a couple from Pleasant Hill, CA reveal to the Sharks the surprising twist they put into their decadent cinnamon rolls. Also, an update on Jim Tselikis and Sabin Lomac from Los Angeles, CA and their Maine lobster roll food truck business, which Barbara Corcoran invested in during Season 4.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: An entrepreneur from Marina Del Rey, CA wants an investment in his e-commerce flower business, which offers bouquets shipped direct from farms on an active volcano for just $40 flat; a man from Encinitas, CA thinks his anti-aging lifting strips for mouth wrinkles is a game changer. A 19-year-old from Plano, TX invented a "breakaway" hanger as a third-grader which collapses under pressure for easy on and off; and two friends from Brooklyn, NY pitch their compostable party tableware made from renewable plant materials. And, Kevin O'Leary follows up on his and Mark Cuban's recent investment in Groovebook, which tripled its sales in just 5 days after airing earlier this season and also drops by "Jimmy Kimmel Live."

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A college sophomore from Oak Brook, IL raised in a traditional Indian family, wants to make her own American dream come true with her flat-folding, reusable storage box. A couple from Carmel, IN hope to cook up a deal with their reinvented cookware, two exuberant moms from Solana Beach, CA have taken the pain out of shoe shopping for your kids with an iPad app that measures foot sizes, and two men from Aurora, IL designed a quick, simple solution to tying up a water balloon. In a first of its kind follow-up, many of the amazing success stories from “Shark Tank” are highlighted, with the entrepreneurs discussing their experiences and how their businesses have grown since coming to the Tank.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Three men from Jackson, NJ with 60 years of painting experience among them, cause the Sharks to get in a feeding frenzy over their convenient way to store a wet paintbrush. Two moms from Austin, TX hope at least one Shark will make an offer for their portable mat that fits into an ultra-compact pouch, two Harvard Business School grads from New York, NY devised a unique way to provide a chef-designed, pre-portioned nutritious meal right to your door, and two men from Park City, UT offer a healthier version of a favorite breakfast with their whole-grain flapjack and waffle mix. Also, an update on Melissa & Rick Hinnant from Leander, TX and their Grace & Lace business that makes hand knitted socks and legwarmers, which Barbara invested in during Season 5.

programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: Two Dallas entrepreneurs demonstrate their smart light bulb which can be programmed from a mobile phone for home or business, a father/son team from Las Vegas have a high-tech replacement for a cork that helps preserve wine and olive oil, parents from Washington, D.C. unveil their subscription service of carefully-curated children's books, but they only have 85 subscribers to date, and a Sarasota, FL woman has a fort-building construction kit for kids that makes castles, pirate ships and cars. Plus, a follow-up on Breathometer, one of the show's most popular deals -- 5 Sharks invested in it earlier this season. It's a breathalyzer app that works with your smart phone to check if you are over the legal alcohol limit and if you are, can call a taxi for you, recommend a hotel and more.

Three men from San Francisco, CA hope to paddle their way into a deal with a collapsible kayak that folds up like the traditional Japanese art of origami, and a couple from Pleasant Hill, CA reveal to the Sharks the surprising twist they put into their decadent cinnamon rolls. programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: An entrepreneur from Marina Del Rey, CA wants an investment in his e-commerce flower business, which offers bouquets shipped direct from farms on an active volcano for just $40 flat; a man from Encinitas, CA thinks his anti-aging lifting strips for mouth wrinkles is a game changer. A 19-year-old from Plano, TX invented a "breakaway" hanger as a third-grader which collapses under pressure for easy on and off; and two friends from Brooklyn, NY pitch their compostable party tableware made from renewable plant materials. programme.title: Shark Tank
programme.desc: A college sophomore from Oak Brook, IL raised in a traditional Indian family, wants to make her own American dream come true with her flat-folding, reusable storage box. programme.title: Shark Tank

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman accused her ex-husband of molesting her daughter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Em says her husband, Shawn, has cheated on her with at least 78 women -- so why does she keep taking him back? Shawn admits to at least 20 affairs but says it’s his wife’s fault that he strays.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Baronica and Nathan say that on July 10, 2021, their then 9-year-old son shot his 8-year-old brother in the chest with one of six unsecured guns in their home. The parents bravely come forward to tell their story in hopes that other parents will learn from their mistakes. Then, Kristin says the last time she saw her 15-year-old son, Ethan, he was heading to his best friend’s house. Within hours, she was informed Ethan had been killed by an unsecured gun in his best friend’s house. Kristin has fought to have Ethan’s Law enacted in CT, which ensures that parents are held accountable for the safe storage of their weapons. And, hear from Susan, whose daughter Amanda was sitting on a park bench when she was shot by a group of young people, leaving her paralyzed. Plus, Ryan Busse, a former gun industry executive who says he left the industry after seeing how fear tactics were being used to sell guns, joins the conversation. This is a show every parent needs to watch -- whether you own a firearm or not.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Craig and Cherie say the last half of their 16-year marriage has been anything but happily-ever-after. Cherie says Craig is chauvinistic, verbally abusive and demands sex, which she admits she only gives him about three to four times a year. Craig says Cherie withholds sex to control him, and as a result, he has become a slave to his anger. Cherie fears the tension in their household is taking a toll on their 11-year-old daughter, who is often caught in the crossfire of their fighting. Dr. Phil challenges the couple to a communication test. Can they heal their wounds and rekindle their romance? Then, meet the couple who inspired the movie, The Vow. Shortly after Kim and Krickitt Carpenter were married, a terrible car crash changed everything. Krickitt lay in a coma for weeks, and awoke with no recognition of her husband. The couple shares their inspiring, though oftentimes heartbreaking, journey of falling in love all over again. How did they find their way back to each other? And what is it like seeing their lives played out on the big screen? If you’ve ever wondered whether love can survive the toughest of challenges, you won’t want to miss this show! This show contains strong sexual content. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Eighteen-year-old Atira is being accused of tearing her family apart. Her mother, Yolanda, sister, Alexa, and brother, Stuart, say the young mom is a "lazy slob," who yells, shoves and cusses, and they’re tired of the chaos she creates. Atira admits she’s full of anger but says her family makes no effort to understand her. Is Atira just an out-of-control, bratty teen, or is a dark secret from her past causing her to lash out? When Dr. Phil digs into this family’s history, will Yolanda, Alexa and Stuart begin to better understand Atira? Then, Atira confronts Yolanda for ignoring her cries for help as a child. Where was her mom when she says she needed her most? Will mother and daughter find a common ground on which to rebuild their relationship? Then, former prosecutor Loni Coombs, author of the new book, “You’re Perfect” ... and Other Lies Parents Tell, joins Dr. Phil. Learn about her six parenting tips for effective listening. Plus, find out how a marshmallow can help you learn critical information about your child’s future, and the most important thing Dr. Phil says you must do with your child every day.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re not getting any younger, and the race is on to say “I do.” Sharon is 48 and says her biological clock is ticking away. She recently got engaged to a man whom she acknowledges is flawed, and she says her family doesn’t approve of her husband-to-be. Can she get them to accept her beau before they walk down the aisle, or do her relatives have a reason to be concerned? Then, Shea from the reality show Southern Belles: Louisville says that as she was planning her big day, she learned that her fiancé allegedly cheated. Now that the wedding is off, can Shea pick up the pieces and move on? Plus, a dating coach explains the biggest dating mistakes women make.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These parents say their precious daughters have turned into bullies. Dr. Phil spells out how "commando parenting" will reshape the behavior of their "little mean girls."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every bride wants to shine on her special day -- from wearing the perfect gown to hosting the most extravagant reception. But what happens when the dream of the perfect wedding turns into a nightmare? Janae knows about this pain firsthand. Her husband, Michael, got so drunk before the ceremony that he passed out cold after saying “I do” and didn’t wake up until the next day! Janae attended the reception by herself and spent her wedding night with her bridesmaids at a hotel. Their wedding from hell took place two years ago, but she still tears up at the memory of that fateful day. Can she ever forgive Michael's mishaps, or is he doomed to the doghouse forever? Then, Angela is a self-professed bridezilla who makes no excuses for her demanding ways. She even created a newsletter for her bridesmaids with the rules and regulations they must follow to participate in her wedding! Her sister and maid of honor, Vanessa, worries that Angela's nitpicking will cause her fiancé, Marvin, to run for the hills. What's behind Angela's controlling behavior, and is she headed for heartache on her special day?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents, listen up! Did you know that 94 percent of American kids ages 12 to 17 use the Internet, and 58 percent of them have an online profile? We're living in a digital world, where photos and other content can be published online for the world to see in an instant. You may not know it, but your child may be one click away from disaster.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They’re self-absorbed, spoiled and entitled brats, otherwise known as Generation Me. MTV correspondent Kim Stolz recently hit the streets of New York to find out how the younger generation feels about this label. Don't miss the candid responses. Then, Bradley, 24, says he wants to be rich and drive a Lamborghini, but he only wants to put in 80 percent of the effort. He still relies on his mom, Christine, to pay his rent and other bills. Will Bradley learn to stand on his own two feet? Plus, Monica says her 18-year-old daughter, Courtney, is an “entitlement princess,” and she gives the teen money just to keep the peace. Will mom and daughter get a wake-up call? And Jean Twenge, author of Generation Me, reveals why many young people are narcissistic.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shara claims that her newlywed husband, Luke, is a “mean, insecure know-it-all” who won’t let her own a cell phone, hold a job or leave the house alone -- and also dictates how she should dress and wear her makeup. Luke denies all of Shara’s allegations and claims that she is “no angel” and has a vicious temper. Can this marriage be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.sub-title: 16 and on the Path of Destruction
programme.desc: A mother describes her daughter's self-destructive behaviors.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.sub-title: Destoni’s Drama: Will She Accept Help? (Pt 2)
programme.desc: Dr. Phil wants a violent teen to meet someone who could change her life. How will she react?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents express frustration with their twin sons' disrespectful behavior.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Darcy says that her sister, Jennifer’s, home is in a state of complete chaos. She says Jennifer and her husband, Ralph, have no rules, their kitchen is bare, the electricity is often shut off, and they put their needs ahead of those of their four children -- who are acting out as a result. Darcy says her nephews, 8 and 10, smoke marijuana, play with weapons and recently started a local forest fire -- and that the 10-year-old once wrote a note asking for someone to kill him in his sleep. She says her 12-year-old niece was recently called to truancy court, and her 16-year-old niece is having unprotected sex in the home with her older, live-in boyfriend. Ralph concedes that he’s struggling to provide for his family financially and has made mistakes as a parent, but says Jennifer is to blame, claiming she’s checked out as a mother. Jennifer admits she’s detached from her family, struggles with depression and has trouble maintaining the household. With this family in dire need of a resolution, Dr. Phil stages a no-nonsense intervention. Are Jennifer and Ralph willing to take the necessary steps to save their family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From marital spats to parenting disagreements, learn the biggest mistakes you're making.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sue says her husband of 12 years, Andy, is verbally abusive and that she’s so scared of him, she remains submissive -- including getting drunk and having sex with him -- to keep the peace. She says, “If he’s going to kill me, he’s going to kill me. I feel like I’m already dead.” So, why is she worried that Andy will leave her? Andy admits that he can be a bully, loses his temper and calls Sue vile names, but he says the duties of a wife are to have sex, cook and clean -- and Sue doesn't carry her weight around the house. After breaking up numerous times, why do they keep reuniting? And, hear from Sue’s two adult children. What do they say contributes to the chaos in their mom and Andy’s relationship? Is there hope for this couple’s marriage, or should they cut ties?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: How to Get to I Do
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: He’s a tough-guy afraid of loosing his freedom. She’s been through two ugly divorces. So when the “M” word comes up, they head for the hills. Join these commitment-challenged singles as Dr. Phil uncovers the reasons why they won’t take the plunge. You’ll also meet a man who, after a four years in a loving relationship, doesn’t see the need to get married. To him it’s just a piece of paper. To her it’s a lot more. Find out if it’s really a “deal breaker.”

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Es kommt ja selten vor, aber diesmal will Endora Darrin wirklich einmal eine Freude machen: Sie zaubert ihm sein Traumauto vor die Tür - den 150 000 Dollar teuren Reactor Mach II. Darrin ist begeistert - bis er erfährt, daß die Konstrukteure über das Verschwinden des Prototyps völlig verzweifelt sind ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: Corn Is As High As A Guernsey'S Eye, The
programme.desc: Tante Clara besucht Samantha und klagt ihr Leid: Da sich alle über ihr Alter lustig machen, würde sie sich am liebsten in etwas ganz Nützliches verwandeln - zum Beispiel in eine Kuh. Als Samantha wenig später Darrin in der Werbeagentur abholt, sieht sie in der Halle die berühmte Preiskuh Ginger für Mortons Milchprodukte-Werbung. Samantha denkt, Tante Clara habe ernst gemacht. Sie nimmt Ginger mit nach Hause und versucht, ihr die Flausen auszureden ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: Trial And Error Of Aunt Clara
programme.desc: Tante Clara (Marion Lorne) weilte auf Lady Montagues Schloß in Schottland, wo sie während einer Jagd einen ihrer Jagdhunde erschossen hat. Nun soll sie aus dem Hexenbund ausgeschlossen werden. Samantha wird zu Tante Claras Verteidigung bestellt. Eine turbulente Gerichtsverhandlung nimmt ihren Lauf ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Endora will Darrin als heimlichen Ehebrecher entlarven. Ohne sein Wissen schenkt sie ihm drei Wünsche. Als sich Darrin in Larrys Auftrag mit dem hübschen Model Buffy beschäftigen muß, sieht dies Endora schon als Erfüllung eines heimlichen Wunsches an. Tatsächlich aber täuscht sich Endora. Als Darrin seine echten Wünsche äußert, hat sie erst mal Sendepause ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Als sich Darrin in der Arbeit nicht mehr an einen Kunden erinnern kann, beschließt er, mit Hilfe seines Sohnes sein Gedächtnis zu trainieren. Er ahnt nicht, daß ihm Endora mittels Zauberei ein perfektes Erinnerungsvermögen zukommen läßt. Von nun an wird Darrin zum unerträglichen Besserwisser, der nicht nur seine Kunden nervt ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Samantha ist dabei, für eine Wohltätigkeitsausstellung ein Stilleben zu malen. Natürlich muß ihr Endora dabei ins Handwerk pfuschen: Sie zaubert ein Landschaftsgemälde des berühmten französischen Malers Henri Monchet hin, das sie sich in einer Ausstellung 'ausgeliehen' hat. Prompt gewinnt es den ersten Preis - und findet sofort einen Käufer ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Samantha und Darrin werden von Darrins altem Schulfreund Charlie Harper (Angus Duncan) auf ein Wochenende eingeladen. Charlie ist ein schwerreicher Mann geworden. Doch während er erstaunlich normal geblieben ist, trägt seine Frau Daphne (Joanna Moore) ihre Nase ziemlich hoch. Als sie ihre Gäste spüren läßt, daß sie Darrin für einen Versager hält, kuriert Samantha Daphnes Dünkel auf Hexenart ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Wieder einmal bringt Tante Clara ein paar Zaubersprüche durcheinander - aus Versehen zaubert sie Königin Victoria (Jane Connell) ins Wohnzimmer. Ausgerechnet als Larry (David White) mit einem Kunden, dem überaus rechthaberischen Mr. Morgan (Robert H. Harris), verhandelt. Der gerät sofort mit der Königin in Streit - was Larry und Darrin einen lukrativen Werbeauftrag einbringt ...

programme.title: La Cruda Realidad
programme.desc: Para conseguir al hombre perfecto tendrá que escuchar al peor de todos

programme.title: Atraco En La Iglesia
programme.desc: Durell Washington y LeeJohn Jackson son dos amigos que se quieren como hermanos. También son un par de torpes delincuentes de poca monta. Cuando Durell se entera de que su ex-novia planea para mudarse a otro estado con su hijo, Durell Jr. - a menos que puedan obtener 17.000 dólares para pagar una deuda - a él y a LeeJohn se les ocurre un plan definitivo y desesperado: atracar la iglesia del barrio. Cuando el dúo se las apaña para irrumpir en la iglesia, descubre que alguien ha jugado. Para conseguir el dinero, Durell y LeeJohn se ven obligados a pasar la noche en presencia del Señor y sus seguidores, consiguiendo un botín mucho mayor de lo que esperaban.

programme.title: Conociendo a Jane Austen
programme.desc: Seis californianos de un club literario se unen para discutir las novelas de Jane Austen. Durante los seis meses siguientes sus matrimonios serán puestos a prueba, surgirán aventuras amorosas y llegará el amor.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: En la pequeña ciudad turística de Nelson, Washington, el querido Jefe de bomberos C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) está acomplejado por su gran nariz. Una astrónoma, guapa e inteligente, Roxanne (Daryl Hannah), acude a la ciudad para estudiar un cometa y se siente inmediatamente atraída por otro recién llegado, el bombero profesional contratado por C.D. Chris (Rick Rossovich).

programme.title: Dick y Jane Ladrones de Risa
programme.desc: Nada más ascender, el ambicioso Dick se ve obligado a comparecer ante las cámaras de televisión para explicar por qué el presidente de su empresa Globodyne se ha desecho repentinamente de sus acciones. Dick se ve envuelto en una especie de escándalo corporativo: en un instante pierde todo lo que pensaba que tenía.

programme.title: Di Que Si
programme.desc: A una pareja poco probable la embaucan para que compita en un reality show de parejas con la única finalidad de sorprender a los productores del programa robando el corazón del público con su incompatibilidad total.

programme.title: El Analfabeto
programme.desc: Cantinflas interpreta a un joven analfabeto que recibe una carta informándole de que un tío rico ha muerto y le ha dejado una gran fortuna. Pero para poder comprender la carta, antes deberá aprender a leer y escribir.

programme.title: Recortes De Mi Vida
programme.desc: Un adolescente es "adoptado" por el chiflado terapeuta de su madre y debe enfrentarse a una familia de excéntricos.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo se adentra en el mundo no regulado de la criptodivisa para detener un ataque inminente, mientras que Red lleva a cabo un arriesgado intento de asegurar su libertad.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Liz y el equipo rastrean a un notorio biohacker clandestino, Red inicia una estrategia para salir de una situación complicada. Mientras tanto, la integridad de Cooper se pone a prueba con una difícil elección.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red se aclimata a su nuevo entorno en la prisión federal, donde un antiguo rival lo desafía. Samar va de incógnito para detener una organización del mercado negro que vende dinero a delincuentes. Mientras tanto, Liz y Jennifer continúan su investigación sobre el pasado de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red sostiene en los tribunales la validez de su acuerdo de inmunidad, Liz y el equipo interrogan a un hombre cuya reciente herencia parece demasiado buena para ser cierta, y Dembe le da algunos consejos a Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cuando envían a Red a una institución médica federal tras su solicitud al tribunal para una evaluación psiquiátrica, Liz y Jennifer aprovechan su ausencia para buscar a un individuo de la lista negra que creen que puede tener información valiosa sobre el pasado de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Mientras Red y Dembe consiguen la ayuda de Glenn para poner al jurado a favor de Red en su próximo juicio, el equipo investiga una serie de misteriosas muertes provocadas por insectos transformados en armas.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz y el equipo hacen una jugada para descubrir la verdad sobre un asesinato internacional en un último esfuerzo por salvar la vida de Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Cooper arriesga su reputación para apelar a la Casa Blanca en nombre de Red, mientras Liz y el equipo reanudan su búsqueda de El Corso, un individuo de la lista negra relacionado con una conspiración internacional. Mientras tanto, las habilidades de Samar en el campo se ponen a prueba.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y el equipo buscan al legendario fugitivo Robert Vesco, uno de los estafadores más destacados de la historia. Mientras tanto, Samar toma una decisión que le cambiará la vida.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red dirige a Liz para que investigue una organización secreta de asesinos contratada por agencias de inteligencia global para eliminar a antiguos agentes: un caso con ramificaciones que cambiarán al equipo para siempre.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo busca a una mujer especializada en adquisiciones hostiles de organizaciones criminales que puede tener información relacionada con una conspiración internacional que involucra a la asesora presidencial Anna McMahon. Mientras tanto, Aram promulga un atrevido plan para sacar ventaja a Red.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Liz y Ressler investigan a un individuo de la lista negra que ofrece borrar las deudas de juego... a un precio engañosamente alto. Mientras tanto, Dembe se preocupa cuando Red pone a prueba las lealtades de sus socios en busca del individuo que lo delató a la policía.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red y el equipo entran en acción para evitar que un grupo terrorista anticapitalista secuestre y torture a niños de familias ricas. Ressler actúa a espaldas de Liz para averiguar qué ha sido de su madre, Katarina Rostova.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: El equipo se dedica a la investigación de un antiguo caso que ha adquirido notoriedad gracias a un popular pódcast de crímenes auténticos. Red visita a Dom Wilkinson en busca de ayuda para una difícil decisión. Ressler descubre algo sobre el pasado de Katarina Rostova.

programme.desc: In a college comedy that puts a modern-day twist on an age-old story, Sydney White tells the tale of a tomboy freshman who ditches her conniving sorority sisters and finds a new home with a group of very dorky outcasts. Fed up with the way they've all been treated, she's off to war against the reigning campus royalty.

programme.title: Bottle Rocket
programme.desc: Three best friends attempt to escape suburban boredom by embarking on a life of crime. They're just not very good at it. James Caan co-stars.

programme.title: Spring Break
programme.desc: Adam Stern and Nelson Dalby, Jr., are naive college students who have come to Fort Lauderdale to perform the rites of Spring Break. Due to a mix-up at their motel, the boys end up in the same room with Stu and O.T., a pair of experienced ladykillers from New York who coach the boys on the finer points of seduction.

programme.title: Butterflies are Free
programme.desc: A free spirit helps a timid, intelligent, young blind man break away from the overprotection of his mother.

programme.title: My Girl 2
programme.desc: Vada visits Los Angeles to research her dead mother's past and makes a surprising discovery about family and love.

programme.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
programme.desc: Kathleen Turner, plays a 43-year-old housewife on the verge of a divorce. When she attends her high school reunion she is named queen of the reunion. As she ascends the podium to accept her crown, she passes out and is tossed into a time warp. She awakens in 1960, a 43-year-old person in a 17-year-old body.

programme.title: See no Evil, Hear no Evil
programme.desc: One of the looniest pictures to come along in some time! STIR CRAZY teams two of the most brilliant and zany comic performers today: Richard Pryor and Gene Wilder. Skip (Wilder) and Harry (Pryor) have both been fired from their jobs, so they take off in their van for California to seek fame and fortune, but somewhere along the way the van conks out and they're broke and...well, they have to eat, right? So they land a gig as singing and dancing woodpeckers to promote a bank opening. When two bank robbers steal their costumes and stick up the bank, guess who gets the blame? Skip and Harry are carted off to the state pen for 125 years. They try to keep their sanity and their lives amidst: a sadistic warden, a hulking mass-murderer and an inter-prison rodeo - all with great hilarity.
